tweets.text: Invoice Builder is an offline-first invoicing application for freelancers and small businesses. It creates and exports invoices and quotes while storing all data locally in a database file, eliminating the need for cloud subscriptions or account registration. https://t.co/Ij9rNAjBQh
@tom_doerr offline-first is such a huge win for freelancers who travel or work in bad signal zones—definitely gonna try this out for my side gigs.
@tom_doerr This is the kind of boring-but-useful open source tool I actually like 😮‍💨 No account, no subscription, your data stays yours. 🔥
